# openEHR Go SDK

> A first-party Go SDK for openEHR. It covers the openEHR REST API, the
> Reference Model as typed Go structs, building and validating Compositions from
> operational templates, AQL, and SMART-on-openEHR authentication. Building-block
> packages (RM, codecs, validation, templates, AQL) import without the HTTP
> client or auth.

The module path is `github.com/cadasto/openehr-sdk-go`. The module floor is Go
1.27.x. The SDK is pre-1.0: pin an exact tag. The specification in the
repository is the source of truth; when code and a spec disagree, the spec wins.
MIT-licensed, developed by Cadasto B.V.

Runnable programs live under `cmd/examples/` and work offline.

## Documentation

- [Install](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/install/): `go get`, the
  Go 1.27.x floor, building-block path vs REST client path.
- [Examples](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/examples/): Showcase
  programs and the full `cmd/examples/` catalog.
- [Packages](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/packages/): Import map for
  building blocks, REST leaves, auth, sandbox, and Cadasto extras.
- [Go reference](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/reference/):
  Redirects to the generated API on
  [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/cadasto/openehr-sdk-go).
- [Contributing](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/contributing/):
  `make ci`, the specification-driven loop, and the docs-site targets.
- [Contact](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/contact/): Cadasto B.V.
  email, reseller sales route, and registered details.
